audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice narrates game strategy over a steady electronic beat. Frequent high-frequency 'swish' and metallic impact SFX trigger every second. (2) Vocal pitch increases sharply as she shouts '完了!' (Finished), accompanied by a series of digital ability chime SFX. (3) A loud 'Wuhu!' cheer followed by an energetic exclamation 'I didn't die!' occurs with a volume swell in the background synthesizer. (4) Rapid speech with high-frequency repetitions and vocal strain during a chaotic combat phase. Sound mix is dense with overlapping explosion and slash effects. (5) Tone shifts to relaxed laughter and melodic commentary. The rhythmic electronic beat remains consistent as the vocal energy lowers to a positive, conversational state.
